snippet.title: Storehand Trailer
snippet.description:
Storehand is now live on Steam — and ready for wishlists!

Step into a cozy organizing game where you clean, sort, stack, and tame the chaos of a messy little store.

If you’ve been following the project, this is the moment — the Steam page is officially up. Take a look, drop a wishlist, and help boost the launch.
